newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan bank auctions bonds worth 4.75bln rupees.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan bank auctions bonds worth 4.75bln rupees.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said it had auctioned six-month short-term federal bonds worth 4.755 billion rupees at a weighted average yield of 16.24988 percent per annum.
The bank recieved bids worth a total of 4.810 billion rupees out of which bids for 4.755 billion rupees were accepted.
In the previous auction held on June 24, bids worth 25.335 billion rupees were accepted at a weighted average yield of 16.05251 percent per annum.
